zh: 将品牌系统应用到零售空间与用户体验场景中，确保线下触点与整体品牌保持一致。
en: Applying the brand system to retail spaces and user experience scenarios, ensuring offline touchpoints align with the overall brand.

zh: 当品牌从产品延展到空间，设计需要在三维环境中继续保持系统的完整性与识别度。
en: As the brand extends from products to spaces, design needs to maintain system integrity and recognition in three-dimensional environments.

zh: 零售空间作为品牌系统的物理载体
en: Retail space as the physical carrier of the brand system

zh: 通过统一的视觉语言与空间逻辑，零售环境成为品牌体验的重要组成部分。
en: Through unified visual language and spatial logic, retail environments become an important part of brand experience.

zh: 系统化的触点设计确保体验一致性
en: Systematic touchpoint design ensures experience consistency

zh: 从导视、陈列到服务细节，每个触点都承载品牌识别。
en: From wayfinding and displays to service details, every touchpoint carries brand recognition.

zh: 空间体验不仅是视觉，更是品牌价值的具象化
en: Spatial experience is not just visual, but the embodiment of brand values

zh: 在真实场景中验证系统的适用性与灵活性。
en: Validating system applicability and flexibility in real scenarios.

zh: 零售空间的成功落地标志着品牌系统的成熟
en: Successful retail implementation marks brand system maturity

zh: 系统在多维度场景中得到验证，为品牌的持续发展奠定基础。
en: The system is validated across multi-dimensional scenarios, laying the foundation for continuous brand development.
